prompt:
XFrame Downloader project art direction: a friendly, thoughtfully designed browser tool that preserves an X/Twitter post around an exported image or video. The brand metaphor is a frame, context, and a downward download gesture. Restrained, confident visual design; a clear URL input, usable customization controls, and one dominant post preview. Original artwork and fictional demo content only.

DIRECTION B / NIGHT SIGNAL. A confident cinematic media-tool identity: near-black navy #0B111B, slate #172331, icy cyan #63E6E2, restrained amber #F4B95B, pale text #EEF7FA. Broad geometric typography, slim technical rules, subtle crop marks. Hero asymmetry: headline and URL on left, a small dimensional glass frame floating through a cyan light beam at upper right, restrained amber download gesture. Dark matte workspace, luminous cyan selected controls, deep charcoal post preview with a narrow amber edge. Subtle film-frame vocabulary; sharp and premium, never busy cyberpunk. Cyan primary download button. Useful editor interface always foregrounded; cinematic light only on hero artwork and preview surround.

Create one polished visual concept of the actual web application, flat front-on screen design, 4:3 landscape composition, no laptop or device mockup. Header: an original compact frame-plus-X-plus-download symbol with wordmark 'XFrame' and small 'DOWNLOADER'. Hero: large headline 'Keep the whole post.' and a short supporting line. Beneath it a wide URL input and 'Load post' button. Main workspace: left narrow settings panel with Image / Video tabs, three theme buttons, five color swatches, PNG / JPG toggle; right large preview canvas containing one dark fictional social post with author 'Alex Morgan', handle '@alexoutside', short text 'Some moments need the whole post.' and a beautiful mountain lake at golden hour image. The preview card is the largest object. Below the workspace a clear 'Download image' button. Preserve this functional hierarchy; generous spacing, high contrast, careful alignment, readable large typography. Small bottom credit 'Developed with OpenAI Codex' and dedication 'For Marcy, with love'. Show a plausible implementable UI, not an abstract moodboard.
